kind_of_no: long-stay park (nights not really for sale)
why: Mostly annual-lease park failing long-stay test 2 and with no price indicator: the operator's last readable page (calamuslodge.com/campground.php, Wayback 2026-05-08) says '25 long-term shaded camp sites ... only rented annually' (status FULL, 'call to join the waiting list'), plus '6 short-term campsites which have a 2-night minimum stay' with water and electric, status not shown, 'Please call for price' - no posted nightly rate, no booking site, no RV Life listing (Algolia park index, 2026-11-05) and not in the Good Sam directory. calamuslodge.com now redirects to an unrelated apartments site (commercialsquareapartments.com, 2026-11-05); Google Maps names the business Calamus Motel & RV, LLC (4.6 from 57 reviews, 308-346-4331) with a new site calamusmotelandrv.com that refused every automated read (Cloudflare 403 / 'Too Many Requests', 2026-11-05). On the fence + mostly seasonal + iffy = drop (AWH 2026-10-31).
name: Calamus Lodge Campground (now Calamus Motel & RV)
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery at 41.82688,-99.19127 (300 m and 1.5 km frames, both rendered, read 2026-11-05): lodge building with a tree-shaded cluster of parked trailers along gravel lanes to its west, inside a rural residential subdivision off Whitetail Ln, ~1.5 km SE of and below the Calamus dam; the Calamus River and the hatchery ponds lie ~500+ m SW behind fields and trees. Below the dam, no water at the sites -> not waterfront.
flags: Not a duplicate and not part of the Calamus Reservoir SRA: it sits in a private subdivision below the dam, ~3.0 km SE of 2680 Homestead Knolls, ~2.0 km N of 15613 Fort Knox, ~8 km from 2681 Nunda Shoal and ~12.5 km from 15611 Valley View Flat. The Google place for 'Calamus Lodge Burwell NE' at 41.92858,-99.30820 (Calamus Outfitters, 308-346-4697) is a different business.

Re-vet if someone can read calamusmotelandrv.com in a normal browser: if it posts a nightly rate (or a booking page sells single/2-night stays) of US$50 or less, the park passes tests 3-5 (2-night standing minimum is fine; 6 of 31 sites, ~19%, short-term; no homes for sale seen) and Google 4.6/57 would be enough for presence. The 2021 capture gave 36 long-term sites with 30/50 A, water, sewer; the 2026-05 capture gives 25 long-term. Short-term sites: water + electric, no sewer, 2-night minimum, 'No maximum' (operator page, Wayback 2026-05-08). Pad size for the short-term sites not stated.
No gateway check run (skip is on test 2, not price).
